root_cause.text: The CPPI descriptor was freed via `k3_cppi_desc_pool_free()` before the `psdata` pointer (returned by `cppi5_hdesc_get_psdata()`) was dereferenced by `emac_rx_timestamp()`, causing a use-after-free on every timestamped received packet.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "cppi5_hdesc_get_psdata() returns a pointer into the CPPI descriptor. In both emac_rx_packet() and emac_rx_packet_zc(), the descriptor is freed via k3_cppi_desc_pool_free() before the psdata pointer is used by emac_rx_timestamp()... Defer the descriptor free until after all accesses through the psdata pointer are complete." The patch moves the `k3_cppi_desc_pool_free()` calls to after the timestamp access in both functions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature descriptor free in zero-copy RX path to prevent use-after-free when XDP buffer references the descriptor.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to k3_cppi_desc_pool_free(rx_chn->desc_pool, desc_rx) in emac_rx_packet_zc.
intent_record.how: The descriptor is no longer freed immediately after obtaining it from the pool, preventing potential use-after-free when the XDP buffer later accesses the descriptor data.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing free of RX descriptor in zero-copy path to prevent descriptor leak.
intent_record.what: Added call to k3_cppi_desc_pool_free() to free the RX descriptor desc_rx after zero-copy packet processing.
intent_record.how: Ensures the RX descriptor is returned to the descriptor pool even when not in the XDP redirect path, preventing descriptor resource leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix premature RX descriptor free that could cause descriptor pool corruption or missed reuse when allocation fails.
intent_record.what: Removed a call to k3_cppi_desc_pool_free() that freed the RX descriptor after stripping CRC bytes and getting tags.
intent_record.how: Previously, the RX descriptor was unconditionally freed early in emac_rx_packet. Now it is not freed at that point, allowing the descriptor to be reused or returned later, preventing premature deallocation and potential memory or descriptor pool issues.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added missing free of RX descriptor in the requeue path to prevent descriptor leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to k3_cppi_desc_pool_free(rx_chn->desc_pool, desc_rx) at the requeue label before pushing a new RX DMA.
intent_record.how: The change ensures that the descriptor (desc_rx) is freed when the RX packet processing code reaches the requeue point, preventing descriptor resource leakage and maintaining proper descriptor pool accounting.
